name: HDB Financial Services Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2007, HDB Financial Services Limited (HDBFS) is a non-deposit-taking NBFC and a subsidiary of HDFC Bank engaged in providing lending solutions.[1]
keyPoints: Business Overview:[1] HDB Financial Services Ltd is a non-deposit-taking NBFC and a subsidiary of HDFC Bank. Classified as an Upper Layer NBFC by the RBI, the company offers lending solutions to individuals, micro enterprises, and businesses through a diversified portfolio across Enterprise Lending, Asset Finance, and Consumer Finance segments.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 11.0% over past five years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Dividend payout has been low at 11.2% of profits over last 3 years
